name: TPROC-C (HammerDB)
description: Standard TPROC-C test template for SQL Server - 100 warehouses, rampup time configurable in tasks

command_template.prepare: hammerdbcli autobuild "dbset db mssqls; dbset bm TPC-C; diset connection mssqls_linux_server {host}; diset connection mssqls_tcp true; diset connection mssqls_port {port}; diset connection mssqls_uid {user}; diset connection mssqls_pass {password}; diset tpcc mssqls_count_ware {warehouses}; buildschema"
command_template.run: hammerdbcli autobuild "dbset db mssqls; dbset bm TPC-C; diset connection mssqls_linux_server {host}; diset connection mssqls_tcp true; diset connection mssqls_port {port}; diset connection mssqls_uid {user}; diset connection mssqls_pass {password}; diset tpcc mssqls_driver timed; diset tpcc mssqls_rampup {rampup}; diset tpcc mssqls_duration {rampup}; vuset vu {threads}; vucreate; vurun; vudestroy"
command_template.cleanup: hammerdbcli autobuild "dbset db mssqls; dbset bm TPC-C; diset connection mssqls_linux_server {host}; diset connection mssqls_tcp true; diset connection mssqls_port {port}; diset connection mssqls_uid {user}; diset connection mssqls_pass {password}; dropschema"
